g.text: W / A / S / D → Move Up, Left, Down, Right
8-way directional propulsion through arterial vessels with dynamic particle trail
Arrow Keys ( ↑ / ← / ↓ / → ) → Move Up, Left, Down, Right
Independent propulsion for Player 2 blue nano-submarine in cooperative play
Unlimited high-velocity laser beams; upgrades to dual and triple-beam angles
Right Control → Fire Primary Laser Cannons
Rapid energy projectiles assigned to Player 2 with dedicated audio feedback
N Key → Launch Rotating Ninja Star (Yellow)
Cuts large Enemy Viruses into two smaller, digestible cells with score bonus
Right Shift → Launch Rotating Ninja Star (Blue)
Player 2 viral-slicing throwing star with custom acoustic sound effects
E (Player 1) / R (Player 2) → Activate / Deactivate Perimeter Saw
Grants frontal invulnerability, deflects incoming bolts, and slices viruses in melee
Surges ship velocity for 3.0 seconds; remaining duration tracked on HUD gauge
C (Player 1) / V (Player 2) → Hold to Charge, Release to Launch
Release before power bar finishes or rocket explodes internally; steerable trajectory
Adjusts rocket Y-axis elevation dynamically in flight to bypass arterial plaque
T: Toggle Full Game Map | F1: Toggle FPS Counter
Reveals upcoming boss checkpoints and active rolling 10-frame tick benchmark
Esc → Pause Game / Return to Main Menu
Instantly pauses simulation and saves checkpoint standings without state destruction
